hypothetical_consumer: clamped normal cosine multiplies an explicitly labeled CPU surrogate history weight
parameter_selection: Mechanism-defined values; no numerical fitting or holdout-driven tuning
families: Each OFAT case changes exactly one listed field from reference; fixed and moving coverage controls additionally freeze stated camera/jitter/object fields together as a named intervention
truth_masks: Immutable per-frame known-visibility/geometry masks computed before any candidate evaluation; same masks and denominator for all methods
light_response: Paired same-seed scenes differing only by global 1.1x linear RGB step; response over first four step frames
oracle_scope: Uses inaccessible per-layer lighting including hidden samples and current exact coverage; not deployable
